paper_title: Constraints on axion-like polarization oscillations in the cosmic microwave background with POLARBEAR
notes: POLARBEAR CMB isotropic time-dependent birefringence search for axion dark matter (Fedderke et al. 'axiverse at the telescope' effect). Lagrangian L = -(1/4) g_phigamma phi F Ftilde (Eq. 1) is exactly the canonical AxionPhoton convention, so g_phigamma = g_agamma with no conversion. Headline/primary result is the STOCHASTIC (Rayleigh-distributed field amplitude) case, Eq. 28: g_phigamma < 2.4e-11 GeV^-1 * (m_phi/1e-21 eV), 95% median upper limit, valid over the mass range 9.6e-22 eV <= m_phi <= 2.2e-20 eV (Eq. 30, corresponding to oscillation frequencies 0.02-0.45 days^-1). The limit scales exactly linearly with mass (g ~ m), so the exclusion boundary is a straight line in log-log; points sampled analytically from Eq. 28. Assumes axion is all of dark matter, rho_0 = 0.3 GeV/cm^3, kappa=1 (Eq. 24). The alternative deterministic case (Eq. 25, g < 1.1e-11 * (m/1e-21 eV)) is 2.2x stronger but the paper reports the stochastic result as its primary constraint. Also shown in Fig. 5. Frequentist limit chosen (paper's choice). Not detected (PTE=0.048).
